description: View execution history of automatic actions (stake, vote, claim) for your pool. Shows status (success/failed/skipped), amounts, transaction hashes, and timestamps. Requires API key.

limit.description: Number of records to return (default: 20, max: 100)

poolAddress.description: Pool address to get history for. If omitted, uses your first registered pool.

name: get_auto_action_history
title: Auto-Action History
